title: Modern LaTeX Editions of Public-Domain Mathematics Manuscripts
description:
This record is the public front page for an ongoing open project to produce modern, inspectable LaTeX editions and translations of older mathematics and physics manuscripts. Public-domain scans and source witnesses are collected, transcribed into TeX, checked into readable PDFs, organized by author/work or coherent corpus, and published with source artifacts so readers can inspect, correct, fork, and continue the work.

Current project map.

  • Main corpus and bulk preservation record: [##########] 100/100 this landing record remains the broad cumulative surface, with reader PDFs, artifact ZIPs, manifests, and full-repository preservation material. Current main record: 10.5281/zenodo.20415117; earlier broad cumulative record: 10.5281/zenodo.20410262; concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20393488.
  • EGA working English translation: [######----] 64/100 EGA I-II are largely inherited from the community translation; current project additions now include EGA 0_IV sections 15 through 23 and EGA IV sections 1 through 10 as substantive working translations. The current English reader is a 748-page working PDF, with all eight NUMDAM French originals included separately as direct top-level PDFs. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20421700.
  • SGA working English translation: [#########-] 85/100 SGA 1-3 English/source snapshots, a combined SGA 4 English reader through Expose XVIII section 2, SGA 4 Exposes I-III complete, Expose IV through section 14, Exposes V-XI complete, Expose XII through section 8, Exposes XIII-XVII complete, SGA 5 opening material, and SGA 1-7 French reference PDFs. Public reader PDFs are organized as coherent volume/expose readers with source packets in ZIP artifacts. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20421261.
  • Non-European and multilingual mathematical manuscripts: [#########-] 90/100 consolidated release for Chinese, Indian/Sanskrit, Islamic/Arabic, and historical-reference mathematical works, organized as 7 combined reader PDFs, 57 direct work-level PDFs, and source/provenance ZIP artifacts. The current public PDFs use clean title pages and human-readable filenames; TeX, source PDFs, OCR notes, page images, and raw process archives are preserved in artifact ZIPs. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20421441.
  • Chinese mathematical classics: [########--] 80/100 corpus page for Chinese mathematical works with language-separated readers and source artifacts; public reader PDFs use clean archive-style front matter. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20421647.
  • Indian and Sanskrit mathematical classics: [########--] 80/100 corpus page for Sanskrit/Indian mathematical works with language-separated readers and source artifacts; public reader PDFs use clean archive-style front matter. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20421650.
  • Islamic and Arabic mathematical texts: [########--] 80/100 corpus page for Arabic/Islamic mathematical works with original-language, translation, and source artifacts; public reader PDFs use clean archive-style front matter. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20421656.
  • Historical reference witnesses: [#######---] 70/100 corpus page for selected historical reference translations and witnesses used to compare terminology and context; public reader PDFs use clean archive-style front matter. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20421657.
  • Heinrich Weber: [######----] 60/100 author page with modern LaTeX drafts for Lehrbuch der Algebra Volumes I and III plus current English draft material from Volume II, including group theory, abelian groups, characters, reciprocal groups, Lagrange resolvents, linear substitutions, transposed substitutions, projective actions, binary substitutions, absolute invariants, form problems, Galois groups, metacyclic groups, abstract groups, alternating groups, orthogonal groups, and fractional linear groups. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20421148.
  • Emmy Noether: [#####-----] 50/100 author page with a selected mathematical-papers modern LaTeX draft, with collected-volume wrapper pages removed, and five current English translation drafts covering the 1910 invariant-theory note, the 1916 finite-groups invariant theorem, integral rational representation of invariants, and an absolute-irreducibility criterion. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20421149.
  • Deligne papers: [######----] 60/100 dedicated record for Deligne paper PDFs and working translation/source material, kept separate so it can be revised or removed independently if needed. Current clean record: 10.5281/zenodo.20414959.
  • Classical algebra and arithmetic manuscripts: [######----] 60/100 organized shelf for selected Cayley, Dedekind, Dirichlet, Gauss, Weber, and Noether modern LaTeX working drafts; 21 top-level reader PDFs passed structural/display checks, with the current Noether reader using the wrapper-removed selected mathematical-papers build. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20418609.
  • Additional author cluster: [######----] 60/100 cleaner reader PDFs and source/provenance artifacts for Minkowski, Hecke, Landau, Steinitz, Hensel, Oka, Hausdorff, Grassmann, Killing, and nearby material; duplicate/mislabelled surface material consolidated, and obvious modern collected-volume wrappers removed from the public PDFs. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20416839.

Workflow. Source scans and witnesses are indexed, converted into TeX drafts, reviewed into readable PDFs, and published with source artifacts for inspection and correction. Reader-facing files are organized by author, work, or coherent corpus; raw process archives are kept in artifact ZIPs rather than in public titles or reader PDFs.

File organization. Top-level PDFs are reader-facing files intended for browsing and direct download. ZIP files contain TeX/source material, source scans or witnesses where appropriate, OCR text, provenance, manifests, and audit outputs. Records are being split by author or coherent corpus while this main record remains the single landing page and bulk preservation surface.

Quality note. These are working scholarly drafts, not final critical editions. Technical PDF audits check whether files open and extract text; they do not prove mathematical correctness. Some drafts still need layout repair, source comparison, theorem-number checking, and human proofreading. Availability is preserved while cleaner organized versions are built.
version: 2026-05-28 public project map refreshed after SGA Expose XVIII, EGA IV section 10, and non-European corpus page updates
notes: Public project landing record. Linked records are organized by corpus or author/work: EGA, SGA, Chinese, Indian/Sanskrit, Islamic/Arabic, historical reference witnesses, Weber, Noether, Deligne, classical algebra/arithmetic, and additional author clusters. Current public surfaces prefer readable PDFs at top level and TeX/source/provenance ZIPs as artifacts. The EGA and SGA records are active working-translation records and will continue to move as translations are completed. Released as CC0/public-domain dedication to the extent possible.
